about_the_game:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. The food is all poisoned. Can you survive in this world?

It is a world of death, where all food for survival has been tainted with poison...

You will embark on a hopeless journey to save a dying humanity.

"What a Wonderful Venom World" is a high-difficulty simulation game where you must find a way to detoxify the unknown poisons to survive.

As you blindly search and experiment, you will face countless unreasonable deaths.

However, beyond that lies the only path to saving humanity.

What is required in this game is your wisdom and perseverance.

  • Unreasonable deaths are a daily occurrence: In a world without right answers, you must relentlessly search for detoxification methods.

  • Despair and hope at the end of trial and error: Each failure might lead to a new hint.

  • Cooperation is key: By sharing seed values, you can exchange information with other players. You might find the collective wisdom to save all of humanity. It's also recommended to challenge it together on live streams.

This game is recommended for those who enjoy repeatedly challenging themselves, as you will face many unreasonable deaths.

Key Features

◆ Auto-Generated Maps

When you start the game, a map is automatically generated.

However, by setting a seed value, you can start on the same map, allowing you to challenge the same world over and over.

◆ Food Detoxification

Your settlement automatically gathers nearby food, but all food in this world is poisonous.

You must specify a detoxification method for the food to produce safe, edible supplies.

If people eat food that hasn't been detoxified, their lifespan will drastically decrease, and the settlement will perish faster.

◆ Settlement Movement

You can move your settlement.

However, food gathering stops during the move, so you should collect enough preserved food before you leave.

New lands may hold new types of food you've never seen before.

Having a variety of foods will also increase your settlement's happiness.

◆ Settlement Division

You can divide your settlement to create new ones.

Since there is a population cap for each settlement, expanding and dividing your settlements is key to increasing the number of humans.

◆ Hints Scattered Throughout the World

Your settlement may discover hints about detoxification during its journey.

Scouring the world will give you a chance to get closer to clearing the game.

◆ Cooperation with Other Players

This game requires a lot of trial and error.

Share your seed values and let other players help you uncover detoxification methods and explore the world.

◆Your Goal in this World

Your ultimate goal as a player is to increase your settlement's population to over 10,000 people.

Find detoxification methods for food, divide your settlements to increase the population, and save humanity from extinction.

name: What a Wonderful Venom World
short_description: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.
